newsitem.title: EU: EP CIVIL LIBERTIES COMMITTEE AGENDA - FEB 4-5.
newsitem.headline: EP CIVIL LIBERTIES COMMITTEE AGENDA - FEB 4-5.

text.p: Committee on Civil Liberties and Internal Affairs [[ Tuesday 04 February 1997 ]] 1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE220.918 ) 2. Approval of minutes of meeting of: - 10 December 1996 (PE219.588 ) ===] In the presence of the Council and Commission 3. Chairman's announcements 4. Respect for human rights in the European Union in 1995 (T04366) (T04366) INI0440 INI0440 + LIBE Fond R ROTH Claudia. (V ) (PE218.951/A ) - Exchange of views Exchange of views on the draft report 5. Creation of a European Monitoring Centre for Racism and Xenophobia (T05353) (T05353) CNS96298 COM(96)0615 + LIBE Fond R FORD James G. (PSE) - Initial exchange of views 7. (PPE) (PE220.285/A ) - Initial exchange of views 8. Any other business 9. Date of next meeting - 24 and 25 February 1997 ===] Tuesday 5 February, 9 a.m. - 12.30 p.m. 10.
